'''Duprel:''' {{legend0|#F1C92A|50–60%}} {{legend0|#DEB02A|60–70%}} | title = U.S. Representative | before_election = [[Dusty Johnson]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Dusty Johnson]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{Elections in South Dakota}} The '''2022 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota''' was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. representative]] from {{ushr|SD|AL}}. The election coincided with [[2022 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2022 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]] and various [[2022 United States elections|state and local elections]]. Incumbent Republican [[Dusty Johnson]] was re-elected with 81.0% of the vote in [[2020 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota|2020]].{{cite web |title=General Election - November 3, 2020 |url=https://sdsos.gov/elections-voting/assets/2020GeneralStateCanvassFinal%26Certificate.pdf |work=[[Secretary of State of South Dakota]] |date=November 10, 2020 |access-date=November 12, 2020 |archive-date=December 18, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201218212956/https://sdsos.gov/elections-voting/assets/2020GeneralStateCanvassFinal%26Certificate.pdf |url-status=dead }} Johnson defeated state representative [[Taffy Howard]] in the Republican primary. No [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] candidate appeared on the ballot, Johnson's only general election opponent was [[Libertarian Party (United States)|Libertarian]] Collin Duprel. Though Johnson won comfortably in a 55-point win, mainly due to competing against a candidate of a [[Minor party#United States|minor party]], Duprel made a bit of a stronger performance than some had expected, with over 22% of the vote.
